title: Chromosome replication across a lineage (seed 0)
interpretation: DNA-polymerase fork positions (oriC->terC), replication-fork pairs, dry mass, and oriC count over a 2-generation lineage. oriC cycles 2->4->2 with each division and forks fire near birth, reproducing the expected replication program at this growth rate.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert/matplotlib on the mac mini
